GitHub advisory and Scout document CVE-2026-118773 for npm glob versions from 9.0.0 through 14.0.1, with fixed releases on the 14.0.2 line. The Vault 2.2.x UI lockfile still resolves glob 9.x and 10.x for Ember tooling; moving all consumers to glob 14.0.2 is a multi-major override that must be validated separately from this CVE line.

GitHub advisory and Scout document CVE-2026-118773 for npm glob versions from 9.0.0 through 14.0.1, with fixed releases on the 14.0.2 line. The Vault 2.2.x UI lockfile still resolves glob 9.x and 10.x for Ember tooling; moving all consumers to glob 14.0.2 is a multi-major override that must be validated separately from this CVE line.

The fix for CVE-2026-118773 is glob 14.0.2. No 11.x release contains the fix, and the glob 11.1.0 copy in Uptime Kuma is pinned as a transitive dependency of its npm tree. Adopting glob 14.x is a semver-major upgrade with breaking-change risk, so it is deferred. Reachability of the resource-consumption path in the shipped runtime is under assessment; this statement will be revisited when the major upgrade is evaluated.
